text:
sam: Quick review please 1: updated Private Setup wizard connectivity card. Main asks: make retry obvious, file name pattern for downloads, and keyboard flow for details. Dropping the current screenshot and probe example.

lina: Prefer the primary CTA be `Run diagnostics` next to the status pill. On narrow screens collapse the action into a single primary + overflow. Avoid the single word 'Failed'  it's scary for users.

mike: Agree. Backend note: the probe returns three top-level statuses: egress_ok, egress_blocked, ssh_unreachable. We can include a short `port_hint` in the summary when we detect a blocked port. Also recommend debouncing the Run button for ~3s and showing spinner in-button.

zoe: Accessibility checklist: status pill needs a visually-hidden prefix like "Probe:" and role=status. Use aria-live: polite for successes, assertive for errors. When details expand, move focus to the panel heading and ensure the toggle has aria-expanded. Keyboard order: status pill -> Run diagnostics -> View details.

sam: Microcopy suggestions: success: "Connected  egress OK"; partial: "Partial connectivity  diagnostics"; fail: "Connection issue  run diagnostics". Keep pill short, put full explanation in expandable details or tooltip.

mike: For the downloadable artifact name: `priv-probe-report-<cluster>-YYYYMMDDThhmmss.json` (user-friendly). Artifact URLs are signed and short-lived; Console should fetch via temporary token and not expose raw S3 links.

lina: UI idea: collapsible card with three regions: summary row (pill + latency), action row (Run diagnostics primary, ? help icon), and expanded details (table of checks + small KB anchors). Animate height change and rotate chevron; on mobile hide latency.

probe-bot: [probe result] 2189992245  status: egress_blocked, artifact available.

sam: Nice. If retries keep failing, show a contextual hint: "Still blocked? Try from your bastion: `curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/health`" and a `Download probe report` button. Do not dump raw logs inline.

zoe: Add aria-describedby on the pill pointing to the details panel id so screen readers have a persistent description. For the download link, add rel=noopener noreferrer and open in new tab.

mike: I'll add port_hint and backoff logic in the probe service; will sanitize the JSON and strip internal trace ids before returning.

sam: Thanks all. Action items: lina updates Figma with mobile/keyboard variants, mike adds port_hint + debounce, zoe compiles the ARIA checklist. Reopen if issues.
